articles.title: Pacers' Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring) out at least 2 weeks
articles.summary: Pacers star Tyrese Haliburton, who is averaging 21.8 points, has a "mild" strained left hamstring and will miss at least two weeks, coach Rick Carlisle said.
